notes.title: A New Beginning: Anaria Is Getting a Full Remake
notes.content:
[h3]📢 Upcoming Update & Roadmap for [i]Anaria[/i][/h3][p]Hey everyone, thank you so much for playing [i]Anaria[/i] and for all the feedback so far!
Your support means the world to me — as a solo indie dev, every comment helps shape the future of the game.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Next Update – Full Remake Incoming![/b]
I'm currently working on a [b]complete remake of Anaria[/b], rebuilding it from the ground up with:[/p][list][*][p]Major performance optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visuals and mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]All known bugs fixed[/p][/*][/list][p]This will be the [b]definitive version[/b] of the current chapter.[/p][p]🎮 [b]After That – Bonus DLC Minigame[/b]
As a creative bonus, a small standalone [b]DLC Minigame[/b] will follow — something fresh, eerie and experimental for the fans of twisted ideas.[/p][p]📖 [b]And Later – Chapter II[/b]
Once the remake and DLC are done, I’ll begin working on [b]Chapter 2[/b], continuing Anaria’s dark story in new terrifying directions.[/p]
